name: Da Vinci
overview: Scripture reveals that God Himself imparts wisdom and skill to individuals for His purposes, as seen in the calling of Bezaleel and Aholiab to craft the sanctuary according to His commands (Exodus 31:1; 35:30; 36:1). This divine empowerment demonstrates that all creative work, including artistry, is ultimately rooted in God's sovereign design. Furthermore, Ephesians 2:10 reminds us that believers are God's workmanship, created in Christ for good works prepared in advance, underscoring that our talents and creativity are gifts to be used for His glory rather than human speculation or deception.
